summary: Explains notifying handlers from a loop, such as `notify: Restart {{ item }}`. The task's changed status is set if any loop item changed, so any change triggers all the notified handlers.
questions: Can I notify a different handler for each loop item?
Why did both handlers run when only one templated file changed?
How does changed status work with loops and notify?

answer_card.title: Notify handlers from a loop
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Template services
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: "{{ item }}.j2"
    dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ item }}.service
  notify: Restart {{ item }}
  loop:
    - memcached
    - apache
```
Handlers are triggered based on the task as a whole. With a loop, the task is changed if **any** item changed, and then **all** the handlers it notifies run. Here both memcached and apache restart if either template changed, and neither restarts if nothing changed.
